newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas,Richemont hold combined 49 pct of Canal Plus.
newsitem.headline: Havas,Richemont hold combined 49 pct of Canal Plus.

text.p: French group Havas and Richemont hold a combined 49 percent of the captial and voting rights in French pay television group Canal Plus , the markets authority CMF said on Tuesday.
The groups' holdings have risen as part of the merger of Canal Plus and Nethold, which is controlled by Richemont, a merger which is due to be completed this month.
